title: Session overview is 7 screens of full theme paragraphs; invites, Edit and privacy are buried at the bottom
what_happens: Each theme shows its whole description (some 20+ lines). The page is 6,432px tall; 'Send on WhatsApp' starts at 6,057px, then 'Edit session' and the privacy card. Themes also have no link to their points or to the synthesis.
who_hurts: Dane opening a session to send invites, edit it or check its privacy has to scroll ~7 screens past text he can't skim; a quick scan of 'what are the themes' is also hard because the titles are lost in paragraphs.
suggested_fix: Clamp each theme description to 2 lines (line-clamp-2) with click-to-expand (a <details> per theme, the pattern 'Edit session' already uses), so all theme titles and counts fit on about one screen and the actions follow.
rule: Dane's UI rule: 'One page, one main job ... give that the top of the page.' + established pattern: 'Edit session' collapsed on the same page
